design_clause: §7 B7 — tool-wire round trip: function-call item -> host result -> function-call-output input -> exact request resume, served on corollary/protocol
why: recorded as RED by the operator who ran the live round trip; the self-check passed, so the server's half is not the cause

registration.name: request_user_input
registration.provenance: scripts/run_b7_roundtrip.py self-check stand-in: U-P1's capture records the installed host's schema DIGEST and keeps the raw request outside this repository, so no in-tree schema can hash to it. This registration exercises the adapter's code path and attests nothing about a host.

self_check.attests: the server's half of B7: the AMD-3 wire shapes over loopback. It attests nothing about the installed host, because the schema digest registered here is a stand-in.

live_codex_log.scan_note: a mechanical scan of the operator-supplied log, not a parse of a format this repository controls. It can refuse a GREEN verdict; it cannot license one on its own.

non_claims: a green self-check is not B7: §7 forbids reporting B7 green from anything but a live host round trip
the text WAITING fallback cannot license B7 or R-U2
